content: To see what is right and not to do it is want of courage.
author: Confucius
explanation: Ethical knowledge without moral execution is cowardly. Confucius demands that when our conscience perceives injustice or truth, we must find the spine to act upon it, regardless of social friction.
practicalInsight: Speak up for an unpopular truth or defend someone absent in conversation today when fairness requires it.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life have you stayed silent about what is right out of fear of social disapproval?
